plugins.name: pipeline-orchestrator
plugins.description: Single-command multi-agent pipeline for Claude Code. Auto-classifies tasks, executes in adaptive batches with adversarial review, defense-in-depth gates, and proportional validation. v4.1.1: stale-lock self-heal — heartbeat field on session locks plus stale-GC on every UserPromptSubmit, so abandoned locks from crashed Claude Code sessions stop blocking edits within 10 minutes (previously up to 2h). Backwards compatible. v4.1.2: cosmetic banner/version-string sync.

plugins.name: skill-advisor
plugins.description: Intelligent toolchain orchestrator for Claude Code — recommends skills, plugins, MCPs, and agents for any task with dependency-aware ordering. v0.5.0: architectural overhaul closing 10-finding audit. Hot-path hook 387→85 lines via lib/advisor-nudge-core extraction; 4 architectural guards CI-enforced (DI-1 module-load purity, DI-2 layered dependency direction, DI-3 manifest version coherence, vault env single source); module-scoped mtime+size cache for embeddings/graph; unified filesystem walker; 812 tests (+24% from 654). BREAKING (restorable): default prompt-length threshold 5→12 chars; restore via ADVISOR_PROMPT_LENGTH=5. Deprecation runway through 0.6.0 for SKILL_ADVISOR_VAULT (use SKILL_ADVISOR_VAULT_PATH) and build-index.inferCategory re-export.

plugins.name: cc-toolkit
plugins.description: Claude Code Swiss Army Knife — diagnose, configure, and build your Claude Code environment. Meta-skill /cc with triage menu + 9 specialized skills for context audit, MCP, hooks, agents, prompts, security, setup, and skill building.

plugins.name: engineering-context
plugins.description: Generates mandatory engineering rules, architecture contracts, anti-pattern catalogs, and validation tests adapted to any project's stack. 6 focused skills: setup, detect-stack, map-architecture, generate-rules, mine-anti-patterns, validate-context.

plugins.name: tts-minimax
plugins.description: Text-to-speech plugin for Claude Code via MiniMax T2A v2 (pt-BR). Hook Stop gera audio automatico apos cada resposta com pre-resumo via GLM-4.5-Air. Player TUI PowerShell com navegacao setas/Enter/X/ESC e auto-refresh. Windows 11 + PowerShell 7.
